what_they_sell.claim: Sastrify offers an AI‑powered platform that automatically discovers and inventories all software tools used by a company.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: Sastrify connects to your systems ... automatically discovers every software tool in use.

what_they_sell.claim: The platform automates renewal alerts, approvals, and vendor tracking to prevent missed renewals.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: Never miss another renewal or chase a contract again. Sastrify automates renewal alerts, approvals, and vendor tracking.

what_they_sell.claim: It benchmarks software contracts and uses AI to recommend fair pricing and optimal renewal timing.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: Sastrify benchmarks every software contract against thousands of live data points. Our AI suggests fair pricing, renewal timing, and negotiation levers.

who_they_sell_to.claim: Sastrify targets IT, procurement, and finance teams within organizations.
who_they_sell_to.cited_excerpt: Sastrify empowers IT, Procurement, and Finance teams with full visibility, automated tracking, and guaranteed ROI on their software landscape.

who_they_sell_to.claim: It serves companies seeking to eliminate shadow IT and enforce software compliance.
who_they_sell_to.cited_excerpt: Eliminate Shadow IT, enforce compliance, and unlock AI‑powered monitoring across your software landscape fast.

outreach_hook.claim: Sastrify raised over $35 million in a Series B round in 2023.
outreach_hook.cited_excerpt: 2023 $35M+ Series B funding with Endeit, Simon Capital and Reimann Investors.
